mentions.title: No more King XP bearings
mentions.snippet: A respected builder reports 2024 and 2025 production-run King main bearings measuring out of spec on free spread, recommending against using them; repeated across multiple production runs, which points at a process issue rather than a one-off.
mentions.replyNote: A new member account identifying as King Bearings posted an official response on 2026-08-04 addressing the precision concerns; thread remains open.

mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread on a diesel truck forum aimed at King main thrust bearings. Page returns 403 to automated reads, so severity is judged from the warning framing in the title alone.

mentions.title: King Main Bearings Defective
mentions.snippet: King STDX main bearings reported with thrust faces over 1mm too narrow to fit BMW S85 and S65 blocks, with the poster arguing a fundamental dimensional miss like this undermines trust in the whole line.
mentions.replyNote: WebFetch redirected to a tollbit.m5board.com mirror instead of returning page content; could not read within the Step 0 fetch budget.

mentions.title: King Bearing - lack of professional help for quality control problem
mentions.snippet: Customer received a sealed King package with mismatched sizes (8x .011 upper, 7x .011 lower, 1x .030 lower) instead of matched pairs, and complains the response was to send it back through the distributor rather than any direct help. Service complaint on top of a packing defect.

mentions.title: King Bearing Failures?
mentions.snippet: Builder found metal and debris in the oil filter during break-in; teardown showed both King main and rod bearings damaged and the crank needing turning. Other posters suggest a cause other than the bearings, so it stays contested.
mentions.replyNote: WebFetch redirected to a tollbit.460ford.com mirror instead of returning page content; could not read within the Step 0 fetch budget.

mentions.title: King Bearings Quality?
mentions.snippet: Mopar forum thread questioning King bearing quality, still open with no King response on file from the previous follow-up check.
mentions.replyNote: Thread is readable and still open; no King or official brand response has been posted and it is not locked or marked resolved.
